calculation.description: Ten-day trend return scaled by relative short-term volatility compression; values are lagged operationally and ranked cross-sectionally. Higher values favor positive trends emerging during compressed volatility.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 through 2027-02-25 (dates with complete aligned data; 2025-2027 qualifying observations)
validation.regime_notes: Strongest in 2025 (10d IC 0.07475); 2027 qualifying sample currently negative (10d IC -0.00955, 30 dates), so monitor drift conservatively. Small 15-asset cross-section; uncertainty is material.

notes: Library correlation must be recomputed by deterministic post-Miner audit; null is not treated as zero.
